answer_1.quote: ViPE, our approach, addresses the limitations found in previous works by leveraging two key findings... to unfold the implicit meaning through a new textual description (elaboration) containing visual symbols.
answer_1.outputs: Visual elaborations, i.e., detailed textual descriptions of visual scenes that convey the intended meaning of figurative language.

answer_2.quote: We propose end-to-end human evaluation and various automated metrics at different levels of granularity.

answer_4.quote: we conducted a user study involving 30 native English-speaking participants aged between 20 and 40 for a comprehensive end-to-end assessment
answer_4.guideline: Participants were presented with a metaphor alongside three images generated from prompts provided by human experts, ChatGPT, and ViPE, and were asked to choose the image that best represented the metaphor's meaning.
